name: touch-playthrough
description: #120: the M3 exit chain, played with touch-layer actions only. One scenario that grows stretch by stretch (63 of 64 Tier 2 slots were taken); the input is the generated segments touch-1-first-battle (runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js; a Tier 1 test checks the files). Each stretch ends on a wait.until, and a timeout fails the scenario. End checks: the field ID is md1_1 (0x75), field mode, Cloud's HP is above 0, and a rerun matches (match). Only frame counts and 1/0 leave.
